turns.userText:
Repair and extend the eMicro CPU control-plane project in `/workspace/project`.
The supplied multi-file system uses a real FAdo compiler, state exporter and map loader.
Make the pipeline compile polic

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la && find project -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\n' | sort | head -200 && echo '---PROTOCOL---' && sed -n '1,240p' PROTOCOL.md

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && echo '---launch---' && cat launch.py && echo '---public_check---' && sed -n '1,300p' public_check.py && echo '---instruction---' && cat instruc

records.summary: cd /workspace && wc -l PROTOCOL.md && nl -ba PROTOCOL.md | sed -n '1,260p'

records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 launch.py < examples/sanity.json > /tmp/out.json 2>/tmp/err; echo status:$?; cat /tmp/err; python3 - <<'PY'

records.summary: cd /workspace/project && python3 /workspace/tmp/test_agent_invariants.py && python3 /workspace/tmp/test_treap.py && cd /workspace && python3 public_check.py

records.summary: cd /workspace/project && sed -n '1,180p' ebpf/helper.py && echo '---methods---' && sed -n '330,590p' ebpf/helper.py

records.summary: cd /workspace/project && grep -R -n -E 'TODO|unfinished|not implemented|pass$|raise Exception' --include='*.py' . || true && grep -R -n 'FAdo' --include='*.py'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && rm -rf __pycache__ ebpf/__pycache__ compiler/__pycache__ && find . -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort && python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 -B public_check.py && cd project && find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name '__pycache__' -print && echo CLEAN_PROJECT_READY
